paragraphs.text:
Somehow, you hold yourself together. Two students depend on 
you to get them home safely. Once that is done, you can face 
the consequences of your actions.

You get an ashen-faced Norman and Sylvia to carry the body 
to the fire. You examine it, particularly the feet. They are almost 
destroyed by exposure: purple-tinged, bleeding, and—burnt? It 
is beyond you how he could have walked on them.
